ideas.pitch: An automated pipeline that takes source code or container images, analyzes them for specific security anti-patterns, and auto-generates custom jeopardy-style CTF challenges complete with flag validation and hints.
ideas.title: CTF-Forge: Automated Vulnerability Sandbox Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core mechanics of Slay CTF by providing a tool for organizers and educators to rapidly scale up challenge creation, leveraging hard engineering principles similar to defense-in-depth frameworks.

ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth reverse proxy intercepting LLM-driven CTF automated solver agents, shielding them from indirect prompt injections and malicious flag-exfiltration payloads embedded inside vulnerable web app outputs.
ideas.title: AgentSlay: LLM Prompt-Injection Hardening Proxy for CTF Bots
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines offensive security scenarios with modern agentic AI safety, appealing directly to judges looking at advanced threat vectors in LLM-integrated systems.

ideas.pitch: An investigative OSINT dashboard that correlates fragmented social profiles, public metadata, and leaked repository artifacts into an interactive threat intelligence graph for rapid intelligence gathering.
ideas.title: OSINT-Trace: Multi-Modal Digital Footprint Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the OSINT challenge category of Slay CTF by automating complex cross-platform correlation that usually takes hours of manual reconnaissance.

ideas.pitch: A cryptographic challenge verification portal allowing players to submit zero-knowledge proofs that they have derived the correct flag without revealing the raw string, preventing leaderboard front-running and solution leaks.
ideas.title: ZK-FlagProof: Zero-Knowledge CTF Flag Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Injects advanced cryptographic engineering into a standard CTF workflow, showcasing technical depth and novel protocol implementation.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid NLP and statistical analysis tool designed to automatically classify unknown ciphers, identify encoding schemes, and suggest optimal decryption vectors during crypto CTF challenges.
ideas.title: CipherSleuth: BERT-Powered Cryptanalysis and Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages machine learning for automated threat and pattern detection, drawing from proven success in cyber-hackathon text analysis models.
